brief: Closes a say { ... } brace of ported Perl or Raku code and prints the answer that a ternary left in the named variable say.
detail: In Raku, say prints the value of an expression. Here the brace body is a Softanza ternary: b(condition) '??' bt(trueValue) '!!' bf(falseValue), which stores its answer in the named variable say, and the end of the brace prints it. The global say is already one of these. A brace that holds anything else prints the previous answer, or an empty line.
